reason: This plugin is primarily an agent workflow bridge that connects Codex to locally running DeepSeek Harness sessions, with MCP tools and a companion UI module for dispatching, steering, and monitoring tasks; it is conservatively moderate risk because it performs session control and local execution wiring, and a manifest reference validation issue currently blocks clean admission.

summaries.zh: 该插件为 Codex 提供 DeepSeek Harness 桥接能力，可在 Codex 中调度本地 DSH 会话并管理任务状态。
summaries.en: This plugin lets Codex work with DeepSeek Harness sessions as a local bridge, allowing task dispatch and session-level collaboration from Codex tools.

capabilities: Communicate with local DeepSeek Harness HTTP RPC endpoints
Dispatch tasks/messages from Codex to DSH via MCP tools
Operate via PowerShell installer/uninstaller scripts to install or refresh plugin components

reasons.code: Repository README describes an MCP bridge and collaboration skill that lets Codex dispatch, steer, and monitor DSH sessions (e.g., create/list/filter sessions, queue/steer messages, wait for completion).
Package metadata includes a DeepSeek Harness companion package (dsh-plugin) with web-client injection and MCP/tooling integration entry points.
The plugin adds local installer/uninstaller PowerShell workflows for Codex and DSH sides, indicating executable local environment changes.
Validation result reports MANIFEST_REFERENCES_VALID failed for dsh-plugin/cordis.patch.yml, indicating a blocking packaging/reference issue.
